subject: SIG questionnaire: ephemeral key proofs & vendor attestation coordination

From: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@alfen.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.co
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 09:13:00 -0400
Subject: Request: SIG questionnaire + ephemeral key proofs for Alfen Therapeutics

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for being available — Alfen is assessing several inference vendors and we need the completed SIG questionnaire plus supporting artefacts focused on ephemeral key usage, key rotation logs, and KMS attestations. Procurement attached the formal request doc (Alfen_SIG_Request.pdf).

High level asks:
- Completed SIG spreadsheet (we'll accept CSV or Excel)
- Recent key rotation logs (last 12 months) showing rotation cadence for ephemeral keys used in session brokering
- KMS attestation or letter from your KMS provider showing control ownership (or equivalent statement)
- Any vendor attestations concerning ephemeral key generation and short-lived credentials

Can you confirm: 1) timeline to provide artifacts, 2) whether you can supply redacted logs to avoid customer PII, and 3) whether we should expect a DocuSign NDA before receiving certain artifacts?

Procurement looped in: procurement@alfen.com

Appreciate a quick confirmation — we are targeting initial vendor shortlisting next week.

Best,
Samir
Samir Gupta
Procurement Lead, Alfen Therapeutics
Attachments: Alfen_SIG_Request.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.co
To: Samir Gupta <samir.gupta@alfen.com>
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.co, aditya_rao@redwood.co
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 10:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire + ephemeral key proofs for Alfen Therapeutics

Samir — thanks for the note and the packet. We can provide everything requested; below is our proposed runbook and owners so you can route internally.

Planned deliverables and timeline:
- Day 2: Completed SIG CSV with control mapping (owner: kimberly_park)
- Day 4: Ephemeral key rotation summary (redacted CSV) + methodology note (owner: mina_haddad)
- Day 6: KMS attestation letter and additional vendor proofs (owner: neha_kapoor)

About redaction: we will redact any customer-identifying fields from rotation logs. We will provide an export that preserves timestamps, key IDs (hashed), rotation events, and principal types. If you need a hashed mapping to reconcile with your records, we can negotiate a separate PO / NDA step.

DocuSign NDA: happy to sign — if Alfen prefers a signed NDA before full logs, we can begin an NDA via DocuSign. Otherwise we can provide redacted summaries immediately.

Next steps:
- Mina, can you confirm which S3 path / audit log set we should extract and whether we need approval from Legal for unredacted export?
- Aditya, I tagged the deal in CRM (DL-2027-0458). Can you coordinate the DocuSign if procurement requires it?

I'll create a secure upload folder and share the link once we have the first exports ready.

Regards,

Kimberly Park
Manager, Security & Compliance Enablement | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: redaction_instructions.md

From: mina_haddad@redwood.co
To: kimberly_park@redwood.co
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.co
Date: Tue, 19 Oct 2027 11:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: SIG questionnaire + ephemeral key proofs for Alfen Therapeutics

Kimberly — quick technical note.

We can extract the ephemeral key rotation events from two sources:
1) Session broker audit (s3://rw-audit/session-broker/YYYY/) — contains rotation_event, key_id (we will hash), principal_type, timestamp
2) KMS audit export (s3://rw-kms/audit-exports/) — contains CMK usage and rotation cycle metadata from our KMS provider

Planned redaction approach: strip IPs, redact customer ids to hashed token, keep timestamps + event_type. Sample schema is attached (ephemeral_key_rotation.csv).

KMS attestation: Redwood uses KeyGuard KMS (third-party) in our EU region; they can provide a vendor attestation letter covering key management controls. I have the template (kms_attestation_template.pdf) — we will request a signed copy and include it.

Constraints:
- Unredacted logs require legal approval and a signed DPA/NDA from the customer.
- Some telemetry includes internal hostnames; we will remove those prior to export.

I'll prepare the redacted CSV and push to a secure upload link by Day 4.

--
Mina Haddad
Principal Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: ephemeral_key_rotation.csv, kms_attestation_template.pdf

2) Procurement requests that the SIG control spreadsheet include a column called "Evidence Location" with links (or upload identifiers) for each control artifact. Can you populate that?
3) DocuSign: procurement will send an NDA if required. Please reply with the preferred recipient email for DocuSign (we’ll send to that address).

Procurement contact copied.

Thanks,
Samir
